verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, Ki cost, CaC usability, and documented mechanics. Preserve unsupported stamina and version-sensitive values as null.
research_scope: Android Kick — Strike Super / Skill Shop acquisition research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository Strike Super coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Dragon Ball documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Android Kick was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Android Kick as a Strike Super Attack.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Android Kick is available from the Skill Shop for the Future Warrior; the skill is also available through partner customization for specified characters.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented acquisition route is the Skill Shop rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: Ki cost is documented as 100. Stamina cost remains null because the reviewed canonical sources do not establish a reliable stamina value.

records.name: Android Kick
records.character_source: Mira / Fu customizable partner / Super Baby 2 customizable partner
records.skill_description: A two-stage Strike Super in which the user performs a somersault and can input the attack again for a quick diving kick.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference describes a high somersault followed by an optional second-input dive kick. Holding back changes the initial movement to a backflip. The second input does not establish an additional Ki cost in the reviewed sources.
records.acquisition_notes: The documented Future Warrior route is purchasing Android Kick from the Skill Shop. Partner customization provides additional character availability and is retained as secondary context.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: The flip has invulnerability/punish utility reported in community patch discussion, but exact frame and matchup claims are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
